note: Remote meeting held under the Governor's COVID-19 order. The 757 Chase Road vote recorded E. Torgersen as unable to vote (he had missed more than one hearing), so it is 3-0 of four members. M. Brenner arrived 7:50 p.m., but the minutes print adjournment at 7:45 p.m. and list him voting on it; the two times conflict. Minutes print no dollar figures and record no public comment, though the preamble says the meeting would feature public comment. The Chase Road and 150 Holman Street motions are printed in the minutes' separate hearing minutes and not in this text; quotes are from the vote lines.
